name: A Devil You Know - An Infernal Dating Sim
source:
Clinging to the last shreds of life, you’ve signed your soul away to a devil! Becoming an infernal plaything trapped in the Hells isn’t ideal, but can you manage to escape the contract?

Or perhaps form an even deeper bond?

A high fantasy and D&D inspired romance sim about a tenacious rogue who got themself trapped in a contract with a cunning half-devil named Mihael.  Navigate through his Hellish manor, survive the dangers that want to eat you whole, and discover the reason why he keeps that painting at the top of the stairs covered up... 

[From [url=https://ikemenaddicts.itch.io/a-devil-you-know]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在命悬一线的弥留之际，你把自己的灵魂签给了一名魔鬼！沦为受困地狱的炼狱玩物固然算不上什么好事，但你能否设法挣脱这份契约？

又或者，缔结下一段更为深厚的羁绊？

这是一款受奇幻文学与《龙与地下城》启发的恋爱模拟游戏：一名顽强不屈的游荡者不慎落入圈套，与狡黠的半魔鬼米哈伊尔签下了灵魂契约。在他的地狱庄园中步步周旋，从妄图将你生吞活剥的重重危机中活下来，并揭开他为何总将楼梯顶端那幅画作严密遮盖的真相……

[摘自[url=https://ikemenaddicts.itch.io/a-devil-you-know]itch.io[/url]]
